en.hubeali:
And from him, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Fazalat Bin Ayoub, from Al Qasim Bin Bureyd, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘From the Sunnah of the Mursil Prophetsas is the cleaning oneself after the toilet, and the circumcision’.
en.sarwar: 6. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Fadalah ibn Ayyub from al-Qasim ibn Burayd from abu Basir who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Of the Sunnah of prophets is draining al-Istinja’ (one’s urine) and circumcision.’”
